links.comparator_used: Baseline Llama 3.2 without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Hallucination rate, Faithfulness and Factual Accuracy on 150 drug-related question-answer pairs
links.effect: Hallucination rate fell from 47.8% to 12.3% (74.3% relative reduction); Faithfulness rose from 0.52 to 0.87; Factual Accuracy rose from 0.54 to 0.89
links.quote: Evaluated on a purpose-built dataset of 150 drug-related question–answer pairs spanning ten commonly used medications and multiple information categories, our RAG system reduces the hallucination rate from 47.8% to 12.3% — a 74.3% relative reduction — while improving Faithfulness from 0.52 to 0.87 and Factual Accuracy from 0.54 to 0.89.
